title: Men Building Wooden Enclosure Outdoors, 1950s Rural B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A vertical black-and-white deckle-edged snapshot capturing two adult men engaged in manual labor outdoors. In the foreground, a sturdy timber frame or wooden box structure is being assembled amid brush and felled lumber. The man on the right, wearing a work jacket and billed cap, points downward into the structure, directing or discussing the work with the second man, who stands inside or beside the wooden framework wearing cold-weather workwear. Tall pines and barren deciduous trees rise in the background under a brightly exposed sky.
